title: 廚餘厭氧消化~Anaerobic digestion of food waste
focus: 從廚餘性質、厭氧反應到沼氣與消化液的完整收支~Close the balances from food-waste properties through digestion, biogas and digestate
summary: 本課以「從廚餘性質、厭氧反應到沼氣與消化液的完整收支」為主軸，依序處理原料驗收與可分解固體、有機體積負荷、水解與反應速率辨識、沼氣能量與輔機邊界、進料中斷與備援重播。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Close the balances from food-waste properties through digestion, biogas and digestate, progressing through Feed acceptance and degradable solids, Organic volumetric loading, Hydrolysis and rate identification, Biogas energy and auxiliary boundary, Feed interruption and backup replay. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 原料驗收與可分解固體~Feed acceptance and degradable solids
units.mechanism: 先在數位卸料區標出塑膠、骨殼與可分解物；總濕重不能直接作為甲烷產量基準。 分率必須以同一濕基或乾基定義；總質量乘分率才是該成分的質量。~At the digital receiving bay, distinguish plastics, shells and biodegradable material; wet mass is not a direct methane-yield basis. Fractions require a consistent wet or dry basis; multiplying total mass by its fraction gives component mass.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總進料 m=1000 kg；目標成分質量分率 f=0.18。公式 m_target=m*f，計算得 180 kg。適用邊界：批次均勻且分樣具代表性；不把質量分率當體積分率。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Total feed m=1000 kg; target-component mass fraction f=0.18. Formula m_target=m*f gives 180 kg. Applicability: A homogeneous batch and representative sampling; mass fraction is not volume fraction.
units.verify: 針對「原料驗收與可分解固體」，秤總樣與分離後成分，保存含水率與分樣方式，檢查回收率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Feed acceptance and degradable solids, Weigh the bulk sample and separated fraction; retain moisture basis and sampling procedure and check recovery. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 濕基與乾基混用會令回收物或負荷被高估。 在「原料驗收與可分解固體」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Mixing wet and dry bases overstates recovered material or loading. Mark where this error can enter the Feed acceptance and degradable solids flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 相同百分比不論濕基或乾基都代表相同質量。~The same percentage gives the same mass on wet and dry bases.
units.practice: 只將 f 改成 0.22，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 180 變成 220 kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only f to 0.22, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 180 to 220 kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 均質槽與含水基準~Equalization and moisture basis
units.mechanism: 將不同來源廚餘的水與乾固體分開記帳，混合目的是穩定進料而非讓所有批次看起來相同。 水和乾固體分別守恆；濕基含水率以總濕重作分母，乾固體重量才能跨不同含水狀態比較。~Track water and dry solids separately across food-waste sources; equalization stabilizes feed rather than concealing batch differences. Track water and dry solids separately; wet-basis moisture uses total wet mass as denominator and dry mass permits comparison across moisture states.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕樣總重 mw=1000 kg；濕基含水率 w=0.30。公式 md=mw*(1-w)，計算得 700 kg dry solids。適用邊界：批次代表性樣本，乾燥減重視為水；揮發性物質或結晶水可能使此假設失效。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet sample mass mw=1000 kg; wet-basis moisture w=0.30. Formula md=mw*(1-w) gives 700 kg dry solids. Applicability: A representative batch sample with drying loss treated as water; volatile matter or bound water may invalidate the assumption.
units.verify: 針對「均質槽與含水基準」，保存稱重、乾燥方法及分樣紀錄，對比重複樣並檢查非水揮發損失。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Equalization and moisture basis, Retain weighing, drying method and subsampling records and compare duplicates while checking non-water volatile loss. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 用濕重比較處理前後會把脫水誤認為固體去除。 在「均質槽與含水基準」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Comparing wet masses can mistake dewatering for solids removal. Mark where this error can enter the Equalization and moisture basis flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 濕樣減重多少就代表固體或污染物被去除多少。~Wet-mass reduction equals the mass of solids or contaminants removed.
units.practice: 只將濕基含水率 w 改成 0.40，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 700 變成 600 kg dry solids。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only wet-basis moisture w to 0.40, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 700 to 600 kg dry solids. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 有機體積負荷~Organic volumetric loading
units.mechanism: 把每日進料濃度與泵送量配對，觀察負荷上升是否早於酸累積與產氣變化。 體積負荷描述單位反應體積每天收到的有機質；增加負荷並不保證生物轉換能力同步增加。~Pair feed concentration with daily pumping and examine whether loading increases precede acid accumulation and gas changes. Volumetric loading measures daily organic feed per reactor volume; a larger load does not guarantee a matching biological conversion rate.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：進料 Q=20 m³/d；有機濃度 S=45 kg/m³；反應體積 V=300 m³。公式 OLR=Q*S/V，計算得 3 kg/(m³·d)。適用邊界：S 的基準須註明 COD、VS 或其他成分，不能互換；未納入抑制或溫度。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Feed Q=20 m³/d; organic concentration S=45 kg/m³; reaction volume V=300 m³. Formula OLR=Q*S/V gives 3 kg/(m³·d). Applicability: State whether S is COD, VS or another constituent; these bases are not interchangeable. Inhibition and temperature effects are omitted.
units.verify: 針對「有機體積負荷」，用同一成分分析方法量進料濃度，和有效體積、泵送量作交叉核對。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Organic volumetric loading, Measure feed concentration on one analytical basis and cross-check effective volume and pumped quantity. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 進料成分突增但流量未變，仍可能造成過負荷。 在「有機體積負荷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A concentration surge can overload the system even when flow remains unchanged. Mark where this error can enter the Organic volumetric loading flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 進料流量固定時有機負荷一定固定。~Organic loading is constant whenever feed flow is constant.
units.practice: 只將 S 改成 54 kg/m³，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3 變成 3.6 kg/(m³·d)。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only S to 54 kg/m³, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 3 to 3.6 kg/(m³·d). Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 停留時間與生物量保留~Residence and biomass retention
units.mechanism: 液體停留與生物量停留可能不同；加入固液分離時，不能只用槽體容積解釋菌群流失。 名目停留時間由有效體積除以通過流量；短流、死區及固液停留差異不在單一平均值內。~Hydraulic and biomass residence may differ; with solids separation, vessel volume alone does not explain biomass washout. Nominal residence time is effective volume divided by flow; short circuits, dead zones and separate solids retention are not represented by one mean.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：有效體積 V=600 m³；平均流量 Q=30 m³/d。公式 HRT=V/Q，計算得 20 d。適用邊界：穩態平均流量及單相有效體積近似，不預測停留時間分布。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Effective volume V=600 m³; mean flow Q=30 m³/d. Formula HRT=V/Q gives 20 d. Applicability: Steady mean flow and a single effective volume; no residence-time distribution is predicted.
units.verify: 針對「停留時間與生物量保留」，先扣除無效空間，再用示蹤或批次記錄核對停留時間是否分散。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Residence and biomass retention, Subtract inactive volume, then compare tracer or batch records to detect a broad residence-time distribution. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把幾何容積當有效容積，會掩蓋短流與未處理區。 在「停留時間與生物量保留」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Using geometric volume as effective volume hides short-circuiting and untreated zones. Mark where this error can enter the Residence and biomass retention flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 有相同平均停留時間的設備，其所有粒子停留時間都相同。~Equal mean residence times imply identical residence times for every particle.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 40 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 20 變成 15 d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 40 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 20 to 15 d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 水解與反應速率辨識~Hydrolysis and rate identification
units.mechanism: 用封閉教學批次曲線比較易分解與纖維性廚餘，識別傳質限制與生物反應限制。 一階模型讓轉換速率與當下濃度成正比，對數濃度對時間近直線。~Compare closed teaching-batch curves for readily degradable and fibrous waste to distinguish mass transfer from biological limitations. A first-order model makes conversion rate proportional to current concentration; log concentration is approximately linear in time.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：初始量 C0=100 mg/L；假設一階常數 k=0.10 d⁻¹；時間 t=10 d。公式 C=C0*exp(-k*t)，計算得 36.7879 mg/L。適用邊界：固定環境與可利用性、無新污染源；不能外推成真實完工日期。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Initial C0=100 mg/L; assumed first-order rate k=0.10 d⁻¹; time t=10 d. Formula C=C0*exp(-k*t) gives 36.7879 mg/L. Applicability: Constant environment and availability with no new source; this does not predict a real completion date.
units.verify: 針對「水解與反應速率辨識」，用多時點數據擬合並保留未參與擬合的點，檢查尾端是否偏離一階趨勢。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Hydrolysis and rate identification, Fit multiple time points, hold some out and inspect late-time deviations from first-order behaviour. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 吸附、傳質或持續源項可造成拖尾，不能只調 k 強行吻合。 在「水解與反應速率辨識」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Sorption, mass transfer or ongoing sources can cause tailing; changing k alone may hide the mechanism. Mark where this error can enter the Hydrolysis and rate identification flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 前兩點符合一階衰減就保證所有後續時間也符合。~Agreement with two early points guarantees first-order decay at all later times.
units.practice: 只將 k 改成 0.07 d⁻¹，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 36.7879 變成 49.6585 mg/L。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only k to 0.07 d⁻¹, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 36.7879 to 49.6585 mg/L. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 揮發性固體與甲烷產率~Volatile solids and methane yield
units.mechanism: 在氣體視窗分開顯示總沼氣與甲烷，並將產量回溯到實際破壞的固體。 甲烷產量依可分解固體與實際轉換產率估算，需區分甲烷體積和含二氧化碳的總沼氣。~Display total biogas separately from methane and relate yield to solids actually destroyed. Methane yield depends on destructible solids and conversion yield; distinguish methane volume from total biogas containing carbon dioxide.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：投入揮發性固體 mVS=500 kg/d；破壞率 r=0.60；假設產率 Y=0.30 m³ CH₄/kg VS destroyed。公式 Q_CH4=mVS*r*Y，計算得 90 m³ CH₄/d。適用邊界：Y 是本題假設，不是任何原料保證值；氣體體積需同溫同壓。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Volatile solids feed mVS=500 kg/d; destruction fraction r=0.60; assumed yield Y=0.30 m³ CH₄/kg VS destroyed. Formula Q_CH4=mVS*r*Y gives 90 m³ CH₄/d. Applicability: Y is a teaching assumption, not a guaranteed feedstock value; compare gas volumes at the same temperature and pressure.
units.verify: 針對「揮發性固體與甲烷產率」，同步記錄進出固體、氣體流量與甲烷比例，做固體與碳收支。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Volatile solids and methane yield, Record inlet and outlet solids, gas flow and methane fraction together; close solids and carbon balances. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把總沼氣當純甲烷，會高估發電潛力。 在「揮發性固體與甲烷產率」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Treating total biogas as pure methane overstates energy potential. Mark where this error can enter the Volatile solids and methane yield flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 沼氣的每一立方公尺都等於一立方公尺純甲烷。~Every cubic metre of biogas equals one cubic metre of pure methane.
units.practice: 只將破壞率 r 改成 0.50，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 90 變成 75 m³ CH₄/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only destruction fraction r to 0.50, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 90 to 75 m³ CH₄/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 沼氣能量與輔機邊界~Biogas energy and auxiliary boundary
units.mechanism: 將氣體淨化、儲氣和發電串聯；含硫與水分的處理需保留獨立設備與性能證據。 化學能乘轉換效率得到毛發電量，再扣輔助用電才是淨輸出。~Connect gas conditioning, storage and generation; sulfur and moisture removal require distinct equipment and performance evidence. Chemical energy multiplied by conversion efficiency gives gross generation; subtract auxiliary demand for net export.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：甲烷流量 q=90 m³/d；低位熱值 H=35.8 MJ/m³；假設電效率 η=0.32。公式 E=q*H*eta/3.6，計算得 286.4 kWh/d。適用邊界：定常氣質與固定效率；未計停機和輔機，用電效率不能超過 1。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Methane q=90 m³/d; lower heating value H=35.8 MJ/m³; assumed electrical efficiency η=0.32. Formula E=q*H*eta/3.6 gives 286.4 kWh/d. Applicability: Constant gas quality and efficiency; downtime and auxiliaries are omitted and electrical efficiency cannot exceed one.
units.verify: 針對「沼氣能量與輔機邊界」，以氣量、甲烷分析及電表對讀，分開列出總發電與輔機耗電。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Biogas energy and auxiliary boundary, Cross-check gas volume, methane analysis and electric meters; list gross generation and auxiliaries separately. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把熱效率與電效率相加後套在發電，會重複計算。 在「沼氣能量與輔機邊界」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Applying combined thermal and electrical efficiency to electricity alone double-counts output. Mark where this error can enter the Biogas energy and auxiliary boundary flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 回收的所有熱能都已經轉成可輸出的電力。~All recovered heat has already become exportable electricity.
units.practice: 只將 η 改成 0.28，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 286.4 變成 250.6 kWh/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only η to 0.28, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 286.4 to 250.6 kWh/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 消化液殘餘負荷~Residual digestate load
units.mechanism: 消化液仍攜帶營養鹽與未轉換有機物；必須追蹤去向，不能將產氣視為所有污染已消失。 流量與濃度共同決定質量負荷；mg/L 乘 m³/d 後除以 1000 得 kg/d。~Digestate still carries nutrients and unconverted organics; track its destination rather than equating gas production with complete pollutant removal. Flow and concentration jointly determine mass loading; divide mg/L times m³/d by 1000 to obtain kg/d.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：流量 Q=120 m³/d；濃度 C=250 mg/L。公式 load=Q*C/1000，計算得 30 kg/d。適用邊界：流量與樣品代表同一時間窗；單點濃度不能代替流量加權平均。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Flow Q=120 m³/d; concentration C=250 mg/L. Formula load=Q*C/1000 gives 30 kg/d. Applicability: Flow and concentration represent the same time window; a grab value does not replace a flow-weighted mean.
units.verify: 針對「消化液殘餘負荷」，對齊流量計與採樣時間，以分時段 Q×C 加總，核對總量與單位。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Residual digestate load, Align flow-meter and sampling timestamps; sum interval Q×C and check totals and units. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只比較濃度會把稀釋當成污染質量已移除。 在「消化液殘餘負荷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A concentration-only comparison can mistake dilution for pollutant removal. Mark where this error can enter the Residual digestate load flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 出流水濃度下降就代表污染總量一定下降。~A lower effluent concentration always means a lower total pollutant load.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 150 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30 變成 37.5 kg/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 150 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 30 to 37.5 kg/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 進料中斷與備援重播~Feed interruption and backup replay
units.mechanism: 在模擬時間線中重播泵故障，分開記錄停止進料、暫存需求和氣體處理的持續需求。 可用率描述指定期間能工作的時間比例，並不等於合格產出率。~Replay a feed-pump failure and separately log feed interruption, storage demand and continuing gas-handling needs. Availability is the working-time fraction over a specified period, not the compliant-output fraction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總計畫時數 T=1000 h；停機 t=60 h。公式 availability=(T-t)/T*100，計算得 94 %。適用邊界：明確定義計畫時間與停機分類；未納入性能降額或品質不合格。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Scheduled time T=1000 h; downtime t=60 h. Formula availability=(T-t)/T*100 gives 94 %. Applicability: Defined scheduled time and downtime categories; derating and rejected output are excluded.
units.verify: 針對「進料中斷與備援重播」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Feed interruption and backup replay, Compare event logs, backup switching and quality data, separating unavailable and nonconforming periods. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「進料中斷與備援重播」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~An online unit with invalid data or nonconforming treatment is not fully effective service. Mark where this error can enter the Feed interruption and backup replay flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 可用率 100% 就能保證所有產出或量測都合格。~One hundred percent availability guarantees all output and measurements conform.
units.practice: 只將 t 改成 90 h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 94 變成 91 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only downtime to 90 h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 94 to 91 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 物質能量收支驗證~Mass-energy balance verification
units.mechanism: 交付同一時間窗的進料、消化液與氣體清單，找出最影響碳收支閉合的不確定來源。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。~Deliver feed, digestate and gas inventories over one interval and identify the uncertainty dominating carbon-balance closure. Relative variances of independent product quantities approximately add; common calibration sources require covariance.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Independent relative standard uncertainties: flow uQ=0.04, concentration uC=0.06. Formula u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty. Applicability: Small-error first-order propagation and independence; standard uncertainty is not a 95% interval.
units.verify: 針對「物質能量收支驗證」，建立每項不確定度來源表，將重複性、校正和代表性分開，檢查相關性。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Mass-energy balance verification, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「物質能量收支驗證」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Mass-energy balance verification flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 重複量測次數越多，所有系統性誤差都會自動消失。~More repeats automatically eliminate every systematic error.
units.practice: 只將 uC 改成 0.03，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072111 變成 0.05 relative standard uncertainty。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only uC to 0.03, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.072111 to 0.05 relative standard uncertainty. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
